index_share.what: patches/apply_mtp_index_share_031.py (LLAMA_MTP_INDEX_SHARE=1, set by the manager): a draft step of the QSA MTP layer gathers the sparse selection a catch-up kept for its sequence plus the cells of every position since, instead of attending densely to the draft's whole cache. A catch-up runs the layer's indexer only when the latest kept selection is > 32 positions behind (LLAMA_MTP_INDEX_SHARE_REFRESH), on views >= 32768 cells (LLAMA_MTP_INDEX_SHARE_MIN_KV); a draft loop reuses a selection at most 48 positions old; every reused cell is clamped to the graph's view. A draft ubatch without outputs stores K, V and the indexer keys only (LLAMA_MTP_STORE_ONLY=0 restores the attention)
